text:
Eli: Quick sync — we've had a few incidents where ingest-side traces lacked SLO annotations and billing buckets. Can we align on a minimal annotation contract?
Maya: +1, ran into this yesterday while debugging latency spike. The missing annotation broke cost attribution query. :grimacing:
Sandeep: Is the ask that edge proxies always add `slo=true|false` and `billing_tier`? We should avoid blowing up header size.
Eli: Ideally yes, but I want to keep the contract tiny. Proposal: add `x-rw-slo` (enum: "slo", "best-effort", "none") and `x-rw-bucket` (short tenant bucket id). Both are optional but documented as high-value for downstream joins.
June: Question — how does this interact with sampling? If a request is sampled out at the edge, we still need those keys on the non-sampled stub or else we lose costing.
Maya: Right. Current sampling chips drop a lot of attributes. We should require that sampling preserves the annotation header (even when body trimmed).
Sandeep: Implementation tradeoff: we can either always copy headers into the mini-envelope we emit for sampled events or have the sampling agent emit a separate `metadata` event that contains the keys — latter keeps envelopes tiny but adds a second stream to join.
Eli: I prefer single-envelope approach for simplicity of downstream joins. Joins across streams are a pain and increase query cost.
June: Single envelope means edge libs must support small prefix copying with a strict whitelist. We need to publish the whitelist and keep it under ~200 bytes.
Maya: Can we compress or map buckets server-side? Suggest edge send short numeric bucket, then enrichment service maps to full billing key. That keeps headers tiny.
Sandeep: Agreed. Also propose we add a version tag: `x-rw-anno-v=1`. That will let us change semantics later without a migration mess.
Eli: Good call. Versioning plus short keys. Let's document: x-rw-anno-v=1, x-rw-slo in {slo,best-effort,none}, x-rw-bucket=<3-6 digit id>. Edge: copy these into sampled envelopes. Enrichment: expand bucket -> billing_key.
June: Operational note: enrichment service must be idempotent and have a TTL lookup for bucket resolution. If lookup fails, annotate `bucket_resolve=unknown` so queries can filter.
Maya: Also add an observability-derived metric: `ingest.annotation_missing_count` per service per hour so we can monitor rollouts.
Sandeep: How about telemetry volume? This increases envelope size slightly. We should run a quick sim against our trace size distribution to estimate cost delta.
Eli: Action items: (1) Sandeep — run size/cost sim by EOD Tue. (2) Maya — draft docs and example edge lib patches. (3) June — plan enrichment idempotency and failure modes. I'll open RFC follow-up with the contract.
ops-bot: Deploy reminder — edge library branch `anno-prefix` is queued for canary tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
Maya: One more thing — for Dedicated/Private customers we need a toggle so they can opt into richer annotation (full billing_key) instead of short bucket. Keep that in the contract via the version header expansion later.
June: Noted. We'll design toggle as config at the proxy side.
Eli: Thanks — small, practical win if we land this. I'll send the RFC-append and schedule a quick 15m sync after Sandeep's sim. :thumbsup:
Maya: :eyes:
Sandeep: Will do.
June: Thanks, team.
